    About Us

    We believe eyes are vital indicators of overall health. That’s why comprehensive eye care at Vue Eyecare goes far beyond a simple prescription. Led by Dr. Phuong Dinh, our team takes the time to truly get to know you, your history, and your specific vision goals.

    Whether you are visiting for a routine exam, looking for the perfect pair of frames, or seeking advanced specialty solutions like Ortho-K and Scleral lenses, we are here to cater to your needs with warmth and precision. At Vue Eyecare, we see eye care through your eyes—providing the expert advice and follow-up you deserve.

    Eye Care

    Quality Eye Care & Treatment

    All eye care services

    • Myopia Control

      Immediate attention for eye emergencies is vital. Our clinic is equipped to handle urgent eye care needs promptly and efficiently. Whether it’s an infection, injury, or sudden vision changes, our team provides expert care to address and treat your eye emergency with compassion and urgency.

    • Dry Eye Treatment

      Experience relief from the discomfort of dry eyes with our specialized dry eye treatment. Tailored to address the unique causes of your symptoms, our approach combines advanced diagnostics with personalized therapy plans.

    • Comprehensive Eye Exams

      Regular eye exams are the cornerstone of maintaining optimal eye health. Our comprehensive eye exams go beyond just determining your prescription; they are a crucial check-up for detecting eye conditions and health issues at an early stage.

    Our Eye Doctor

    Your Baton Rouge Eye Doctor

    The team at Vue Eyecare, led by Dr. P.T. Dinh, applies the latest, proven medical treatments, providing outstanding results in eye care. Dr. P.T. Dinh also offers eye care tips and advice to help you maintain healthy eyes and vision for life.

    P.T. Dinh, OD, MS, IACMM

    Dr. Phuong T. Dinh is an experienced and highly skilled optometrist proudly serving the community of Baton Rouge. He moved to the United States with his parents and older sister in 1974 following the Vietnam War and later graduated from Catholic High School. Dr. Dinh continued his education at Louisiana State University (LSU), where he earned his Bachelor of Science degree, and went on to complete both his Master of Science and Doctor of Optometry degrees at the University of Houston in 2005.

    Show More

    Dr. Dinh provides comprehensive routine and medical eye care, including contact lens fittings, dry eye treatment, eye infection management, glaucoma care, and retinal evaluations. He holds advanced certification from the International Academy in Myopia Management and has specialized expertise in orthokeratology (Ortho-K) for myopia control, as well as scleral lens fitting for keratoconus and post–refractive surgery patients. He is known for his thorough, respectful, and patient-centered approach, always striving to deliver individualized care with professionalism and compassion.

    Dr. Dinh has also participated in mission work providing essential eye care to underserved communities in Haiti and Honduras—experiences he considers deeply humbling and meaningful.
    Appreciated for his warm personality and uplifting sense of humor, Dr. Dinh is often told by patients that he could pursue a second career in stand-up comedy—a compliment he receives with gratitude and good humor.

    Outside of the exam room, Dr. Dinh enjoys country music, fishing, hunting, woodworking, playing guitar, cooking, baking, and traveling with his wife and two daughters. He considers it a true privilege to care for the eye health of individuals and families throughout Baton Rouge, Denham Springs, and the surrounding communities, as well, he remains committed to serving with integrity, compassion, and gratitude.

    Services

    Our Most Popular Eye Care Services

    Contact Lenses

    Discover the freedom and comfort of contact lenses with our personalized fitting service. Whether you're new to contacts or looking for an upgrade, we offer a wide range of options to suit your vision needs and lifestyle.

    Our experts will guide you through the selection process, ensuring a perfect fit for optimal comfort and clear vision. Embrace the convenience of contact lenses and enjoy the world with a new perspective.

    Contact Lens Fitting

    Eye Disease Treatment

    Preserving the eyesight of our patients so they can get the most out of life is our greatest goal.

    Our Eye Care Clinic makes it a policy to ensure that all staff members are up-to-date on the latest technology and techniques to make your visit as comfortable and effective as possible. As optometric technology changes, it is even more important to visit an eye doctor who has all the right optometry qualifications and follows the latest developments in eye care.
